```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data1 = read_csv("sdss_ddr14.csv")
data2 = read_csv("6 class csv.csv")
```

```{r}
convert_str = function(str){
  if(str == "blue white"){str = "blue"}
  if(str == "yellowish white" || str == "yellow-white"){str = "yellow"}
  if(str == "pale yellow orange" || str == "yellowish"){str = "yellow"}
  if(str == "blue-white"){str = "blue"}
  if(str == "whitish" || str == "white-yellow"){str = "white"}
  if(str == "orange-red"){str = "orange"}
  return(str)
}
convert_str = Vectorize(convert_str)
```

```{r}
data2 = data2 %>% 
  mutate(color = `Star color`|> str_to_lower())

data2$color = data2$color |> convert_str()
```

```{r}
color_palette <- setNames(c("#FF2400", "#42cef5", "#e8f6fa", "#e9f542", "#f59942"), unique(data2$color))

plot = ggplot(data2, aes(x = `Temperature (K)`, y = log(`Luminosity(L/Lo)`), color = "black",
                 fill = color, size = `Radius(R/Ro)`))+
  geom_point(shape = 21, stroke = 1)+
  scale_x_reverse()+
  scale_color_manual(values = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette, labels = c("Blue", "Orange", "Red",
                                                       "White", "Yellow"), 
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))+
  guides(color = FALSE)+
  scale_size(range = c(3, 10)) +
  labs(y = "Luminosity (L/Lo)", fill = "Star Color")+
  theme_classic()

plot
```

```{r}
get_all_plots = function(data2){
  color_palette <- setNames(c("#FF2400", "#42cef5", "#e8f6fa", "#e9f542", "#f59942"),
                            unique(data2$color))
  
  density_palette = c("red", "blue", "green", "yellow", "orange", "purple", "pink", "brown")
  
  density_legend_labels <- unique(data2$`Spectral Class`)
  
  plot = ggplot()+
    geom_point(data = data2, 
               aes(x = `Temperature (K)`, y = log(`Luminosity(L/Lo)`), color = "black",
                   fill = color, size = `Radius(R/Ro)`),
               shape = 21, stroke = 1)+
    scale_x_reverse()+
    scale_color_manual(values = "black")+
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette, labels = c("Blue", "Orange", "Red",
                                                         "White", "Yellow"), 
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))+
    guides(color = FALSE)+
    scale_size(range = c(3, 10)) +
    labs(y = "Luminosity (L/Lo)", fill = "Star Color")+
    theme_classic()
  
  vetor = unique(data2$`Spectral Class`)
  n = length(vetor)
  
  for(k in 1:(n-1)){
    ggobj = stat_density_2d(data = data2[data2[["Spectral Class"]] == vetor[k],],
                            aes(x = `Temperature (K)`,
                                y = log(`Luminosity(L/Lo)`)),
                            geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2,
                            fill = density_palette[k])
    plot = plot+ggobj
  }
  
  ggobj = stat_density_2d(data = data2[data2[["Spectral Class"]] == "O",],
                            aes(x = `Temperature (K)`,
                                y = log(`Luminosity(L/Lo)`)),
                            geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2,
                            fill = density_palette[n])
  plot = plot+ggobj
  
  return(plot)
}

get_all_plots(data2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = data1, aes(x = `u-g`, y = log(redshift), color = class))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x = "U-G", y = "Redshift (Log)", color = "Class")+
  theme_classic()
```


```{r}
data1_plot = data1[data1["redshift"] > 0, ]
data1_clean = data1_plot[,c(15,19)]
data1_clean$redshift = log(data1_clean$redshift)
#data1_clean = data1_clean |> lapply(scale) |> as.data.frame()

set.seed(69)
clusters = kmeans(data1_clean, centers = 3)

data1_plot$clusters = unlist(clusters$cluster) |> as.factor()

ggplot(data = data1_plot, aes(x = `u-g`, y = log(redshift), color = clusters))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x = "U-G", y = "Redshift (Log)", color = "Class")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "#E41A1C", "2" = "#4DAF4A", "3" = "#377EB8"),
                     labels = c("Quasar", "Galaxy", "Star"))+
  theme_classic()
```
